verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a local LLM runner. The pack only shows that Jan imports GGUF files and that its server is powered by llama.cpp. No evidence mentions quantization levels, bit-widths from very low-bit to 8-bit, or memory-footprint reduction. Treating GGUF or llama.cpp as proof of quantization support would rely on an underlying engine or outside knowledge, not documented product capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can reduce memory footprint using integer quantization ranging from very low-bit to 8-bit precision
